description: VRM Export & Accessory Integration: Add VRMC_springBone extension to VRM output, implement proper glTF index remapping for accessory baking, and add production hardening with commercial profile checks.
steps: 1. Add create_springbone_extension() function to vtuber_pipeline/avatar/vrm_builder.py that builds VRMC_springBone extension JSON
2. Wire create_springbone_extension() into export_vrm() to add VRMC_springBone to glTF extensions
3. Implement proper index remapping in vtuber_pipeline/accessory/bake.py bake_accessories(): remap node/mesh/material/accessor/bufferView indices when merging
4. In vtuber_pipeline/avatar/build.py Stage 3, check for commercial/production profile and raise exception on TripoSR failure instead of fallback
5. Fix final status logic in build.py: 'failed' if validation didn't pass, 'partial' if any stage is error/stub/fallback, 'complete' only if all stages succeeded
acceptance_criteria: VRM output contains VRMC_springBone in extensionsUsed
bake_accessories() correctly merges accessories with remapped indices
Commercial profile raises exception on TripoSR failure (no silent fallback)
Pipeline status accurately reflects stage completion state
verification: Check that generated VRM has both VRMC_vrm and VRMC_springBone extensions
findings:
All 5 steps implemented successfully:
1. Added create_springbone_extension() in vrm_builder.py - builds VRMC_springBone JSON with springs and jointEdges
2. Wired springbone_config parameter through export_vrm() - adds VRMC_springBone to extensionsUsed when config provided
3. Implemented full index remapping in bake_accessories() - remaps node children, mesh primitives, accessor bufferViews, and sparse accessor indices
4. Added commercial/production profile check in build.py Stage 3 - fails fast without fallback when profile='production' or profile='commercial'
5. Fixed final status logic - now returns 'failed' if validation fails, 'partial' if any stub/fallback stages, 'complete' only if all stages succeed

All 5 integration tests pass including new test_springbone_extension and test_commercial_profile_hard_fail tests.
